WholesaleCTA.Title: Wholesale & export customers
WholesaleCTA.Description: For large volume orders and international export, submit the form with "Wholesale" or "Export" as subject. Our sales team will prepare a custom quote for you.

FAQ.Title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.Subtitle: Quick answers to common questions about our products and services.

Item1.Question: What shrimp products do you offer?
Item1.Answer: We specialize in premium breaded shrimp (Crevette Panée) in four delicious varieties: Pistachio, Almond, Corn Breadcrumb, and Spicy. Available in individual boxes (6, 8, or 12 pieces) and restaurant boxes (300, 600, or 900 pieces).

Item2.Question: How do wholesale orders work?
Item2.Answer: For wholesale and export orders, submit the contact form with your requirements. Our team will contact you within 24 hours with custom pricing and logistics details.

Item3.Question: Can I mix different varieties in one box?
Item3.Answer: Yes! Each box can contain up to 2 different varieties. For example, you can have half pistachio and half spicy in a single box.

Item4.Question: Do you deliver internationally?
Item4.Answer: Yes, we handle international export orders. Contact us with your country and desired quantities, and we'll provide shipping options and pricing.

Hero.Title: About
Hero.Description: We are a student-led club dedicated to nurturing emotional intelligence, moral values, and meaningful human connection within our school community.

Vision.Title: A World Where Every Voice Matters
Vision.Subtitle: We believe that schools can be spaces of genuine emotional growth — where students, teachers, and parents connect beyond grades.
Vision.Statement: To build a school culture where emotional intelligence, empathy, and moral courage are as valued as academic achievement.
Vision.SubStatement: Habib Thameur Secondary School — Spark Club

Pillar1.Title: Emotional Awareness
Pillar1.Description: Helping students understand and express their feelings safely and constructively.

Pillar2.Title: Community Belonging
Pillar2.Description: Creating a space where every student, teacher, and parent feels heard and valued.

Pillar3.Title: Character Growth
Pillar3.Description: Encouraging moral values and positive character development through shared experiences.

Mission.Title: What We're Here to Do
Mission.Subtitle: Our mission is to raise awareness about emotional intelligence and create a safe, anonymous space for meaningful self-expression.
Mission.Point1: Raise awareness about emotional intelligence and its role in daily life.
Mission.Point2: Provide an anonymous platform for students to share thoughts, feelings, and moral lessons.
Mission.Point3: Foster positive interaction between students, teachers, and parents through shared stories.
Mission.Point4: Promote a culture of empathy, respect, and constructive dialogue in our school community.
Mission.CardDescription: Our platform is built for the entire school community — from students navigating emotions to teachers seeking connection and parents looking to support their children.

Values.Title: The Principles We Stand By
Values.Subtitle: Every feature we build and every decision we make is guided by these core values.

Value1.Title: Privacy
Value1.Description: We protect the identity of every user who chooses to share anonymously. Trust is the foundation of our community.

Value2.Title: Empathy
Value2.Description: We lead with compassion and encourage every interaction to be kind, respectful, and understanding.

Value3.Title: Inclusion
Value3.Description: Every student, teacher, and parent belongs here. We celebrate diversity of thought, culture, and experience.

Value4.Title: Positivity
Value4.Description: We curate a space focused on growth, encouragement, and the belief that things can get better.

Value5.Title: Education
Value5.Description: We believe in continuous learning — not just academically, but emotionally, morally, and socially.

Value6.Title: Authenticity
Value6.Description: We encourage genuine self-expression. Real stories and honest thoughts spark real change.

Founders.Title: The People Who Started It All
Founders.Subtitle: Our founding team had a simple but powerful dream: to make our school a kinder, more emotionally aware place.
